series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: Through 2026, 20% of organizations will use AI to flatten their organizational structure, eliminating more than half of current middle management positions.
entries.subject: AI and middle management
entries.metric: share of organizations using AI to flatten structure
entries.note: Also: eliminating more than half of current middle management positions in those organizations.

entries.quote: By 2028, technological immersion will impact populations with digital addiction and social isolation, prompting 70% of organizations to implement anti-digital policies.
entries.subject: Digital addiction policies
entries.metric: share of organizations implementing anti-digital policies

entries.quote: By 2029, 10% of global boards will use AI guidance to challenge executive decisions that are material to their business.
entries.subject: AI in board governance
entries.metric: share of global boards using AI guidance to challenge executive decisions

entries.quote: By 2028, 40% of large enterprises will deploy AI to manipulate and measure employee mood and behaviors, all in the name of profit.
entries.subject: AI monitoring of employee sentiment
entries.metric: share of large enterprises deploying AI to manipulate and measure employee mood and behavior

entries.quote: By 2027, 70% of new contracts for employees will include licensing and fair usage clauses for AI representations of their personas.
entries.subject: AI personas in employment contracts
entries.metric: share of new employee contracts with licensing and fair usage clauses for AI personas

entries.quote: By 2027, 70% of healthcare providers will include emotional-AI-related terms and conditions in technology contracts or risk billions in financial harm.
entries.subject: Emotional AI in healthcare contracts
entries.metric: share of healthcare providers including emotional-AI terms in technology contracts

entries.quote: By 2028, 30% of S&P companies will use GenAI labeling, such as “xxGPT,” to reshape their branding while chasing new revenue.
entries.subject: GenAI branding
entries.metric: share of S&P companies using GenAI labeling in branding

entries.quote: By 2028, 25% of enterprise breaches will be traced back to AI agent abuse, from both external and malicious internal actors.
entries.subject: AI agent abuse and security breaches
entries.metric: share of enterprise breaches traced to AI agent abuse

entries.quote: By 2028, 40% of CIOs will demand “Guardian Agents” be available to autonomously track, oversee, or contain the results of AI agent actions.
entries.subject: Guardian agents for AI oversight
entries.metric: share of CIOs demanding guardian agents

entries.quote: Through 2027, Fortune 500 companies will shift $500 billion from energy opex to microgrids to mitigate chronic energy risks and AI demand.
entries.subject: Corporate microgrids
entries.metric: energy opex shifted to microgrids by Fortune 500 companies

notes: Edition covers '2025 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: 'top 10 strategic predictions'). Found in public source: 10 top predictions.
